Getting here

The business describes the school as opposite SuperValu on Newcastle Road. It moved to this venue in 2006 according to its location page.

By car

The published directions approach from the N4 via Lucan crossroads and Esker Church. Use live directions for the current road layout.

By public transport

Bus route details can change. Check your journey with Transport for Ireland before travelling.
